description: D1-D5 and crisis cases reuse the accepted matrix. These are partial audit declarations, not live campaign observations. Current stocks, route, host, mission and affordability gates remain unresolved. C7 surrender_progress 0.9 is the prior handoff assumption, not a measured save value.

scenarios.label: Train shortage. Exact trains, convoy access, affordability and host state unresolved.
Mismatch pressure. Exact incident receipt, field package, supply and cost inputs unresolved.
Total mobilization. War is declared; workplace burden, output, support and phase gates unresolved.
Blockaded licensing. Foreign partner, convoy route, autonomy and recipient scope unresolved.
Low-value baseline close. Peace is declared; review age, reliance, experience and mission state unresolved.
Supply failure and recent core loss. Flags are audit assumptions; native fuel, train, field affordability and reassessment binding unresolved.
Near capitulation. surrender_progress 0.9 is an audit assumption from handoff 19; active mission, host, finance and exact crisis trigger unresolved.
